'''Hull''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] worker. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he took part in the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|resettlement initiative]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], but eventually informed Governor [[Leontyne Saresh]] that he and his men would stop working due to the threat of [[rakghoul]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
Hull is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
